author: Cortez727
quote: 13 years. 13 years I've been waiting for this. What a letdown. A ridiculous amount of anticipation, only to end up this disappointed.PERFORMANCEThe frame rate drags down the entire experience. Driving, shooting, moving around: all of it should feel smooth and responsive. Instead, the sluggishness constantly gets in the way of enjoying myself. Graphics only impress me for so long once they start hurting my eyes.STORYThe worst of any GTA. Absolute trash, in my opinion. I struggled to care about what was happening, and the terrible writing gave me little reason to stay invested. I kept waiting for it to get better. That's a **** feeling to sit with when the story is one of the main reasons I play these games.HEISTSAnother massive disappointment. Underwhelming, none of the excitement I expected, and very little payoff for the buildup.MECHANICSClunky. Basic actions feel more awkward than they should, and the controls make every other problem more **** REVIEWSWhat makes all of this worse is how deceived I feel by the glowing reviews. The praise set expectations my experience came nowhere close. These problems seriously hurt my enjoyment, and the reviews barely prepared me for any of them.That is why I'm being harsh, I want this review to carry some weight. Anyone thinking about buying it deserves to hear how frustrating and disappointing it can be, even with all that hype behind it.Thirteen years of waiting made this hit hard. Feeling misled by reviewers made it worse, 0
